visualReview.notes: Inspected all seven current portable views against the individually inspected local north and east exterior photographs and statue detail. The 36 outer Doric columns, two entrance columns, raised terrace, separate granite and marble stair flights, inset attic and open portal with seated silhouette are represented. Final review corrected the recessed roof and clipped ornament projecting beyond a frieze corner.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Inspected all seven current shared-material views including the north-up placement overlay, plus the full shared front view. Marble, granite, painted metal and membrane retain metric-scale bindings; local terrace ground remains distinct. Flat shared ground is a material fixture; independent terrain is in the portable scene.

mediumFiReview.notes: Inspected all nineteen final lighting, quality and forced-detail frames. Skyline retains the colonnade, inset attic and major steps; district resolves recessed roof fields. Finer levels restore flutes, wreaths, balustrades and simplified statue. Synthetic neighbors are style fixtures. No physical-device frame-rate measurement is claimed.

fidelityReview.scope: Temple exterior, upper retaining terrace, main stair flights and simplified seated Lincoln silhouette; reflecting pool, distant approaches and detailed interiors excluded.
fidelityReview.notes: Original medium-fi exterior from individually inspected local Qualla photographs, NPS dimensional statistics, and individually viewed 2008 elevation, longitudinal section and chamber plan. Column count, dimensions and overall massing follow these controls. Fine inscriptions, carvings, optical corrections, roof panels and statue likeness are approximations; no readable inscriptions or portrait fidelity is claimed. Side chamber murals, undercroft and temporary construction are excluded. No photo pixels are embedded.

Columns, attic, central portal and major stairs remain at distance; flutes, trim and relief return progressively. Error values are authoring budgets, not measured mesh deviations.

limitations: Original medium-fi temple exterior based on individually inspected local Qualla photos, mapped parts and NPS statistics/2008 plan and elevation; not a measured survey.

NPS dimensions control the column count, spacing, height and major massing. Fine carvings, inscription strokes, statue likeness, optical corrections and exact roof panels are simplified; inscriptions are not claimed readable.
Seated statue is an original simplified silhouette visible through the portal, not a portrait-quality replica. Side chamber murals, inscriptions, undercroft and detailed interiors are excluded.
Upper terrace and main granite/marble stair flights are included. Reflecting pool, lower pool steps, distant approachway, temporary construction and surrounding gardens are excluded.
Independent terrain is preserved unchanged; foundation extends beneath it. Another host DEM can change exact ground contact. No reference photo pixels are embedded.
